title: Fort Edmonton Park is hosting authentic paranormal tours at its most haunted hotspots
excerpt: We've rounded up everything you'll want to know about the Fall Paranormal Tours currently being hosted at Fort Edmonton Park.
content:
Fall Paranormal Tours are back for the season at Fort Edmonton Park, with the popular, authentic investigation event running all the way into December.

Fort Edmonton Park has brought back its paranormal tours this fall, and we couldn’t be more excited. In this experience, guests are taken through authentic paranormal investigations. According to the Park, you’ll get to visit some of the most haunted hotspots while hearing the best-kept ghost stories they have to offer.

If you’re searching for one of the most authentic spooky experiences this Halloween season, look no further.

What to expect from the Fall Paranormal Tours at Fort Edmonton Park

On select days from now until Dec. 2, Fort Edmonton Park will be offering these tours. They typically last around three hours, giving you ample time to learn how to use various tools and techniques like Echovox, Spirit Box, Motion Detectors, Recording Devices, Laser Grids, and EMF Readers.

This year, the two options include the 1885 Street Venture or the Fort Featured Investigation, which takes you through the impressive Rowand House.

The 1885 Street Venture, according to Fort Edmonton Park, is a hotspot for paranormal activity, with documented paranormal encounters across multiple locations. With this tour, you’ll visit spots like Kelly’s Saloon and the Bellerose School, with “possible access” to other historic buildings.

As for the Fort Featured Investigation, the Rowand House is “back by popular demand.”

Though the Rowand House is not an original Fort building, it is one of Fort Edmonton Park’s most paranormal active buildings. According to the Park, experiences can range from hearing footsteps running to seeing shadows moving.

Fort Edmonton Park also notes that since the investigations are authentic, there is no guaranteed paranormal interaction. If a building is “quiet,” other buildings may be investigated during the tour.

How much are tickets?

Tickets are available online and cost $67 plus tax per person for either investigative experience (1885 Street Venture or Fort Featured Investigation).

Whether you’re with friends, family, or taking on the investigation with a group of curious strangers like yourself, these investigations are going to be absolutely fascinating. Grab your coat, get your boots on, and prepare yourself for a chilling, thrilling experience,

When: Select dates now until Wednesday, Dec. 2, 2026
Time: Various times
Where: 7000 143rd St. NW, Edmonton, Alta.
Cost: $67 plus tax
